title: Stallion Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (Unit II), Ahmedabad, India
summary: India's 1st EDGE Advanced Certified High-Rise Residential Building
description:
Recognized as **India’s 1st EDGE Advanced Certified** Pharmaceutical Project and **1st ‘EDGE Zero Carbon Ready’** Project, this pharmaceutical manufacturing facility was completed in 2021 with a built-up area of 11,211 m². The EDGE certification process, initiated in 2020, was successfully achieved in 2021, marking a significant accomplishment. Certified under the **EDGE Green Building Certification system** (IFC - World Bank Group) and verified by Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI), the project sets a benchmark in sustainable, resource-efficient, and low-carbon industrial development. 

**EDGE ADVANCED – Key Achievements:** 
1. 100% Energy Savings
2. 61% Water Savings
3. 40% Reduction in Embodied Energy in Materials
4. 0.0 tCO?/year Operational CO? Emissions
5. 342.62 tCO?/year Operational CO? Savings

title: Cigna
description: Cigna’s commercial interior project in Hyderabad, India, is certified under the **LEED v4 ID+C (Commercial Interiors) rating system**, incorporating comprehensive energy simulation to enhance building performance. Certified by Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI), the project has achieved the prestigious Platinum rating level and stands as a benchmark for excellence in sustainable interior design and environmental performance.

title: The Aga Hall Estate
summary: India’s 1st EDGE Advanced Certified High-Rise Residential Building
description:
Recognized as **India’s 1st EDGE Advanced Certified High-Rise Residential Building**, The Aga Hall Estate in Mumbai, India, is certified under the **EDGE Green Building Certification system** (IFC – World Bank Group) by Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI). Completed in 2025, with a total built-up area of 47,491 sq. m., the project demonstrates exemplary performance in sustainable residential development.

**EDGE ADVANCED – Key Achievements:** 
1. 40% Energy Savings
2. 49% Water Savings
3. 32% Reduction in Embodied Energy in Materials
4. 1,822 tCO?/year Operational CO? Emissions
5. 1,215 tCO?/year Operational CO? Savings

title: Denver International Airport – Concourse A
description: The Concourse A West Expansion at Denver International Airport is certified under the LEED v4 BD+C (New Construction – Campus Approach) Green Building Certification system. The project demonstrates excellence across key sustainability parameters and has achieved the prestigious PLATINUM certification, reflecting high standards in energy performance, environmental responsibility, and sustainable infrastructure development.
